propositions: Current Rebar structured-output behavior including deterministic repair, schema extraction, three-attempt ceiling, stop-reason fast-fail, and bounded retry truncation must be preserved or explicitly approved for change in the Pydantic AI 1.107.2 migration.

Offline integration probe using real Pydantic Agent/output/retry/limits/hooks seams verified 19/23 declared scenarios with zero live model calls and confirmed pydantic-ai-slim resolves to exactly 1.107.2.

Seven maintainer decisions were approved: one operation-wide request budget with raise-the-limit follow-up, complete failed response on proven fit else whole omission, bounded output-size retry with concise guidance, terminal refusal/content-filter, aggregate successful-run usage, exact cause-chain exception restoration, and trace-based candidate observability.

Four explicit behavioral deltas require intentional handling: successful-retry usage aggregation counts all attempts rather than accepted-only, exhaustion re-raises exact Rebar-owned output error from cause chain rather than blanket UnexpectedModelBehavior, candidate fallback/downgrade attempts emit trace events not usage counts, and request budget is shared between tool turns and output retries.
Behavioral contract matrix maps 38 deduplicated rows to 15 historical ticket aliases plus ADR 0056, 23 upstream-seam experiments, and 290+ passing unit tests across 13 source suites.
Implementation ticketization remains gated pending pydantic-ai lane (story 155c); Phase-4 research is complete with all checkout-local artifacts excluded from repository snapshots per design.
